summary:
Iteration 3 — Retest of the helper-bubble CSS fix in /app/frontend/src/App.css (.transcript-message.helper-message { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px }). Frontend-only testing per review request against https://iris-logs.preview.emergentagent.com. Executed a Playwright script against the public preview URL: (1) opened /login, clicked [data-testid='demo-access-btn'] (no Discord redirect), (2) dashboard listed the 3 demo tickets, opened ticket-row-TKT-0891, (3) measured bounding boxes of [data-testid='transcript-message-demo-891-2'] and [data-testid='transcript-message-demo-891-4'] on desktop 1920x1080: outer 620x66, inner content
581x66, inner

553x20 — width > 200 px and height < 100 px on both helper messages. (4) [data-testid='transcript-message-demo-891-1'] (member) renders correctly at 620x66 with inner 581x66. (5) [data-testid='vocal-play-button'] is visible, enabled, clickable — click toggles [data-testid='vocal-waveform'] class to 'waveform is-playing'. (6) Mobile 390x800 dashboard: document.documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 and body.scrollWidth == 390 — no horizontal overflow. The regression flagged in iteration_2 is RESOLVED and no side effect was observed on member messages, vocal widget, or mobile layout. Screenshots captured for both desktop workspace and mobile dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css line 497 fix is correct and minimal: .transcript-message.helper-message swaps to grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px while keeping img { order: 2 }, so the content div (order 0) lands in the 1fr track and the avatar in the 28px track. Behaviour matches iteration_2's suggested one-line mitigation.
No other member/helper style regression detected — member message keeps 28px minmax(0,1fr) columns as before and renders identically to iteration_2.
Vocal widget (play button + waveform + text summary) is untouched and still works.
Mobile responsive layout at 390x800 stays inside the viewport (no horizontal scroll).
Minor (non-blocking): the demo login button spinner is not cleared before window.location.assign (already noted in iteration_2). No user-facing impact.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (helper bubble fix + member render + vocal button + mobile no-overflow all pass)

The helper-message vertical-text regression is fully fixed. If future iterations restructure the transcript to flex/row-reverse, keep the following stable data-testids: transcript-message-{message.id}, transcript-message-demo-891-1..4, vocal-play-button, vocal-waveform, ticket-row-TKT-0891, demo-access-btn. Assertion thresholds that catch the bug: on 1920x1080, inner

of a helper-message must have width > 200 and height < 100.
rca of the issue:
Iteration 2 diagnosed the root cause: CSS Grid `order` reorders children into the visual grid tracks, so `img { order: 2 }` was landing the avatar in the 1fr track and the content div in the 28px track, collapsing text to 1 char per line. The applied fix reverses grid-template-columns to `minmax(0, 1fr) 28px` for the helper variant only, so the 1fr track is now the visually-first (left, content) track and the 28px avatar sits on the right — matching the intended right-aligned helper bubble. Verified: helper

width jumped from 0 px to 553 px and height dropped from 1229 px to 20 px on demo-891-2 and demo-891-4.
